The '''Bryexx system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Varvenna sector/Legends|Varvenna sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bryexx]].
